scope: Dense unmasked attention with FP32 softmax and accumulation. One busy AIV, ND row-program hypothesis. Full DN layouts, compiler allocation, spill selection and instruction-cache effects are not reconstructed.

reference.interpretation: 256-byte register, 64 FP32 lanes. Arithmetic, row reduction and cast use nominal 64 lanes/cycle, expdiff/div use 16. Load/store represent one contiguous register transaction. FP32-to-FP16 cast, register-result latency and mixed-pipe capacities are design assumptions here. No kernel-window regression.
